hallelujah3T: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, glory to Thee, O God. (3 times)
gloryForever: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen.
trisagion: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (3 times)
mostHolyTrinity: O Most Holy Trinity, have mercy on us. O Lord, blot out our sins. O Master, pardon our iniquities. O Holy One, visit and heal our infirmities for Thy name’s sake.
ourFather: Our Father, Who art in the heavens, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
oHeavenlyKing: O Heavenly King, Comforter, the Spirit of Truth, present in all places and filling all things, the Treasury of blessings and Giver of Life: Come and abide in us, and cleanse us from every impurity, and save our souls, O Good One.
comeLetUsWorship:
Come, let us worship God our King!
Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ, our King and our God!
Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ himself, our King and our God!
easterSuggestion:
From Easter until Ascension, say instead of O Heavenly King...

Christ is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and upon those in the tombs bestowing life. (3 times)

From Ascension until Pentecost, begin with the Trisagion Prayers.
hymnToTheTheotokos: It is truly meet to bless thee, the Theotokos, ever-blessed and most blameless, and Mother of our God. More honourable than the Cherubim, and beyond compare more glorious than the Seraphim, who without corruption gavest birth to God the Word, the very Theotokos, thee do we magnify.
hymnToTheTheotokosShort: More honourable than the Cherubim, and beyond compare more glorious than the Seraphim, who without corruption gavest birth to God the Word, the very Theotokos, thee do we magnify.
stEphremPrayer:
O Lord and Master of my life, a spirit of idleness, despondency, ambition, and idle talking give me not. (Prostration)

But rather a spirit of chastity, humble-mindedness, patience, and love bestow upon me thy servant. (Prostration)

Yea, O Lord King, grant me to see my own failings and not condemn my brother; for blessed art thou unto the ages of ages. (Prostration)
